full_judgment:
Md. Muzammel Hossain J. This petition for leave to appeal under Article 103 of the Constitution of Peoples' Republic of Bangladesh is directed against the judgment and order dated 26.10.2008 passed by the High Court Division in Civil Revision No.4361 of 1999 discharging the Rule upon affirming the judgment and decree dated 20.07.1999 passed by the learned Additional District Judge, 2nd Court, Dhaka in Title Appeal No.92 of 1997 dismissing the appeal thereby affirming the judgment and decree dated 09.04.1997 passed by the learned Sub-Ordinate Judge, 5th Court, Dhaka in Title Suit No.186 of 1996 dismissing the suit. 

 2. The petitioner and his brother as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No.310 of 1984 in the Court of Sub-Ordinate Judge, 1st Court, Dhaka for declaration of title by way of adverse possession of the suit land and that the registered deeds of sale dated 15.11.1971, 05.12.1983 and 14.12.1983 are false, fabricated and not binding upon the plaintiffs. Thereafter the suit was transferred to the 5th Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka and re-numbered as Title Suit No.186 of 1996. 

 6. The learned Sub-Ordinate Judge, 5th Court, Dhaka by the judgment and decree dated 09.04.1997 dismissed Title Suit No.186 of 1996. Being aggrieved by the aforesaid judgment and decree the plaintiffs petitioners preferred appeal being Title Appeal No. 92 of 1997 in the Court or District Judge, Dhaka. The learned Additional District Judge, 2nd Court, Dhaka by the judgment and decree dated 20.07.1999 dismissed the appeal. Thereafter being aggrieved by the judgment and decree dated 20.07.1999 the plaintiffs-petitioners preferred revisional application before the High Court Division being Civil Revision No.4361 of 1999. A Single Bench of the High Court Division by the judgment and order dated 26.10.2008 discharged the Rule.
